scripts.build: npm run build -w @growtix/shared-types && npm run build -w @growtix/api && npm run build -w @growtix/workers && npm run build -w @growtix/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,workers "npm run dev -w @growtix/api" "npm run dev -w @growtix/web" "npm run dev:workers"
scripts.dev:workers: npm run build -w @growtix/api && npm run dev -w @growtix/workers
